passages.title: 越過圍牆的芒果
passages.text: Our neighbor, Mr. Chen, has a big {1} tree in his yard. Every June, its branches hang over our wall, and ripe mangoes drop into our garden. One morning, I found six of them on the ground. I wanted to eat them all, but Mom said, "They aren't ours. We should {2} them." So I put them in a basket and knocked on Mr. Chen's door. He smiled and said, "You're so honest! Keep three for your family." The next week, he gave us a bag of green {3} from his garden, too. To thank him, Mom baked a {4} cake, and I took it to his house. Now our two families share food all the time. Mr. Chen often says, "A good neighbor is {5} more than a sweet mango."

blanks.why: a mango tree「芒果樹」，後面說熟芒果掉進我們的院子。museum（博物館）、factory（工廠）、village（村莊）都不能接 tree，也不會結芒果。
return them「把它們還回去」，因為芒果不是我們的。spell（拼字）、boil（煮沸）、marry（結婚）都和「不是我們的」這個理由無關。
a bag of green beans「一袋四季豆」，是他菜園種的。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不是菜園裡長的。
pumpkin cake「南瓜蛋糕」。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能做成蛋糕來道謝。
be worth more than…「比…更有價值」。wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）、illegal（違法的）都不能接 more than 表示價值。

passages.zh: 我們的鄰居陳先生家院子裡有一棵大芒果樹。每年六月，樹枝會越過我們家的圍牆，熟透的芒果就掉進我們的院子。有一天早上，我在地上撿到六顆。我很想全部吃掉，但媽媽說：「那不是我們的，應該拿去還。」於是我把芒果放進籃子裡，去敲陳先生家的門。他笑著說：「你真誠實！留三顆給你們家吧。」下個星期，他又送我們一袋自己菜園種的四季豆。為了謝謝他，媽媽烤了一個南瓜蛋糕，由我送去他家。現在我們兩家常常互相分享食物。陳先生常說：「一個好鄰居比一顆甜芒果更珍貴。」

passages.title: 英文課的南瓜燈
passages.text: Last October, our English teacher, Ms. Lin, brought a big orange {1} to class. "Today we're going to make a jack-o'-lantern for Halloween," she said. First, she cut a hole in the top and asked us to take out the seeds with our hands. It felt wet and strange, and some girls {2}, "Eww!" Then we drew a scary face on it, and Ms. Lin carefully cut out the eyes and the mouth. When she put a small light inside and turned off the classroom lights, everyone said, "Wow!" At lunch, she gave us hot {3} soup made from the inside of it. She also made a salad with {4} and green {5}. It was the most delicious English class ever.

blanks.why: brought a big orange pumpkin「帶了一顆大橘色南瓜」來做南瓜燈。pocket（口袋）、uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）都不能挖洞、取出種子。
摸到濕濕怪怪的種子，有些女生大叫 shouted「噁！」。spelled（拼字）、borrowed（借）、married（結婚）都不能接引號裡的叫聲。
pumpkin soup「南瓜湯」，用挖出來的南瓜肉煮的。garbage（垃圾）、homework（功課）、traffic（交通）都不能煮成湯給學生喝。
沙拉裡有番茄 tomatoes。letters（信）、tickets（票）、corners（角落）都不能拌進沙拉。
green beans「四季豆」，也是沙拉的材料。pockets（口袋）、offices（辦公室）、villages（村莊）都不能吃。

passages.zh: 去年十月，我們的英文老師林老師帶了一顆很大的橘色南瓜到教室。「今天我們要做萬聖節的南瓜燈。」她說。首先，她在頂端切了一個洞，叫我們用手把種子挖出來。摸起來濕濕的、怪怪的，有些女生大叫：「噁！」接著我們在南瓜上畫了一張可怕的臉，林老師小心地把眼睛和嘴巴割出來。她在裡面放了一盞小燈，再關掉教室的燈，大家都喊：「哇！」午餐時，她請我們喝用南瓜肉煮的熱南瓜湯，還做了番茄和四季豆沙拉。這是史上最好吃的一堂英文課。

passages.title: 第一次做番茄炒蛋
passages.text: My parents both work late on Fridays, so last week I decided to cook dinner by myself for the first time. I chose an easy dish: {1} with eggs. I watched a video online and wrote down every step. First, I cut two tomatoes into small pieces. Then I {2} three eggs in a bowl. Everything was going well until I put too much salt in the pan. The dish tasted terrible! So I added some sugar and one more {3}, and it tasted much better. I also boiled some green {4} as a side dish. When my parents came home and saw dinner on the table, they were very {5}. Dad ate two bowls of rice and said, "Next Friday, the kitchen is yours!"

blanks.why: 番茄炒蛋 tomatoes with eggs，後面說把兩顆番茄切小塊。pockets（口袋）、tickets（票）、offices（辦公室）都不是菜的材料。
mix eggs「把蛋打散攪拌」。prayed（禱告）、married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）接 three eggs 都不通。
太鹹了，所以加糖和多加一顆番茄 tomato 調味。ticket（票）、pocket（口袋）、letter（信）都不能加進菜裡。
boil green beans「燙四季豆」當配菜。letters（信）、museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）都不能煮來吃。
爸媽回家看到晚餐已經煮好，覺得很驚訝 surprised。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容人的感受。

passages.zh: 我爸媽星期五都工作到很晚，所以上星期我決定第一次自己煮晚餐。我選了一道簡單的菜：番茄炒蛋。我在網路上看影片，把每個步驟都寫下來。首先，我把兩顆番茄切成小塊，接著在碗裡把三顆蛋打散。一切都很順利，直到我在鍋裡放了太多鹽，那道菜難吃極了！於是我加了一些糖，又多放一顆番茄，味道就好多了。我還燙了一些四季豆當配菜。爸媽回到家，看到晚餐已經擺在桌上，都非常驚訝。爸爸吃了兩碗飯，說：「下星期五，廚房交給你了！」

passages.title: 大湖草莓園的紅嘴巴
passages.text: Last winter, my class went on a field trip to Dahu in Miaoli. The town is famous for its {1}. At the farm, the farmer gave each of us a small basket and said, "Only pick the red ones. Please be {2}, or you'll hurt the plants." My friend Kevin picked fast and ate even faster. After half an hour, his basket was empty, but his mouth was red! The farmer laughed and said, "You have to pay for those too." Besides strawberries, the farm also had cherry {3} growing in a greenhouse. At the end, we each made a small cake. I put five big {4} on mine and took it home for my mom. She said it was the most {5} cake she had ever eaten.

blanks.why: 大湖以草莓 strawberries 出名，後面就去採草莓。offices（辦公室）、tickets（票）、factories（工廠）都不是農場採的東西。
Please be gentle「請溫柔、輕一點」，否則會傷到植物。rude（無禮的）、lazy（懶惰的）、ugly（醜的）都和「才不會弄傷植物」無關。
cherry tomatoes「小番茄」，種在溫室裡。pockets（口袋）、uniforms（制服）、museums（博物館）都不會在溫室裡長出來。
在蛋糕上放了五顆大草莓 strawberries。letters（信）、bills（帳單）、corners（角落）都不能放在蛋糕上當裝飾。
the most delicious cake「最好吃的蛋糕」。careless（粗心的）、lonely（寂寞的）、honest（誠實的）都是形容人的，不能形容蛋糕的味道。

passages.zh: 去年冬天，我們班去苗栗大湖校外教學，那裡以草莓聞名。到了農場，農夫給我們每人一個小籃子，說：「只摘紅色的，動作要輕，不然會傷到植物。」我朋友 Kevin 摘得很快，吃得更快。半小時後，他的籃子空空的，嘴巴卻紅紅的！農夫笑著說：「那些也要算錢喔。」除了草莓，農場的溫室裡還種了小番茄。最後，我們每個人做了一個小蛋糕。我在我的蛋糕上放了五顆大草莓，帶回家給媽媽。她說那是她吃過最好吃的蛋糕。

passages.title: 外婆的綠豆湯
passages.text: Every summer afternoon, my grandma makes a big pot of mung {1} soup. She says it helps us feel cool on hot days. Last Sunday, I asked her to {2} me how to make it. First, we washed the beans and put them in water for an hour. Then we boiled them with sugar until they became soft. Grandma said, "Don't put in too much sugar, or it won't be {3}." While we waited, she cut up a {4} for me and told me about her childhood. "When I was young, we didn't have a fridge, so we put the soup in a well to keep it cold," she said. That evening, my whole family ate the soup with some {5} on top. That was my idea! Grandma said it looked a little strange, but she still ate two bowls.

blanks.why: mung bean soup「綠豆湯」，後面說把豆子洗好泡水。ticket（票）、pocket（口袋）、letter（信）都不能煮成湯。
teach me how to…「教我怎麼…」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、pray（禱告）都不能接 me how to make it。
糖放太多就不健康 healthy 了。wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）、illegal（違法的）都和糖放太多沒有關係。
cut up a mango「切一顆芒果」給我吃。uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）、factory（工廠）都不能切來吃。
綠豆湯上面放幾顆草莓 strawberries，外婆覺得看起來有點怪。tickets（票）、offices（辦公室）、museums（博物館）都不能放在湯上面吃。

passages.zh: 每年夏天的下午，外婆都會煮一大鍋綠豆湯。她說天氣熱的時候喝了會覺得涼快。上星期日，我請外婆教我怎麼煮。首先，我們把綠豆洗乾淨，泡水一個小時，然後加糖一起煮，直到豆子變軟。外婆說：「糖不要放太多，不然就不健康了。」等待的時候，她切了一顆芒果給我吃，還跟我講她小時候的事。「我小時候沒有冰箱，所以我們把湯放進井裡冰。」她說。那天晚上，全家人一起喝綠豆湯，上面還放了幾顆草莓，那是我的點子！外婆說看起來有點怪，但她還是喝了兩碗。

passages.title: 番茄鐘讀書法
passages.text: Lily is a ninth grader, but she always played with her phone instead of studying. One day, her teacher told her about the "Pomodoro Technique." "Pomodoro" means {1} in Italian, because the man who started it used a red, round kitchen timer that looked like one. Here's how it works: you study for 25 minutes, and then you {2} for five minutes. After four rounds, you take a longer break. Lily tried it. During the breaks, she ate a few {3} or some dried {4} and didn't touch her phone. In the beginning, 25 minutes felt very long. But after two weeks, it became a habit. Her grades {5} a lot, and her mom was very happy. Now Lily tells all her friends, "A tomato saved my test scores!"

blanks.why: Pomodoro 在義大利文是番茄 tomato 的意思，因為發明者用的計時器又紅又圓，看起來像番茄。ticket（票）、pocket（口袋）、museum（博物館）都不是紅色圓形的東西。
讀 25 分鐘，然後休息 rest 五分鐘，後面也說之後會有較長的休息。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、boil（煮沸）都不是讀書中間的休息。
休息時吃幾顆草莓 strawberries。uniforms（制服）、offices（辦公室）、villages（村莊）都不能吃。
dried mango「芒果乾」。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、homework（功課）都不能當點心吃。
grades improved「成績進步了」，所以媽媽很高興。married（結婚）、spelled（拼字）、prayed（禱告）都不能用成績當主詞。

passages.zh: Lily 是九年級學生，但她總是在玩手機而不讀書。有一天，老師跟她介紹了「番茄鐘工作法」。「Pomodoro」在義大利文是番茄的意思，因為發明這個方法的人用的廚房計時器又紅又圓，看起來就像一顆番茄。做法是：讀書 25 分鐘，然後休息五分鐘；四輪之後，再休息久一點。Lily 試了一下。休息時，她吃幾顆草莓或一些芒果乾，不碰手機。一開始，25 分鐘感覺好漫長，但兩個星期後就變成了習慣。她的成績進步很多，媽媽非常開心。現在 Lily 都跟朋友說：「一顆番茄救了我的考試成績！」

passages.title: 外星人在我家吃宵夜
passages.text: One night, a small green alien landed in my backyard. His name was Zork, and he was very {1}. I took him to the kitchen and opened the fridge. First, I gave him a {2}. He held it up and asked, "Is this a little red planet?" Then he ate it in one bite and smiled. Next, he tried some {3}. He didn't like them and made a funny face. Then I gave him a yellow {4}. He loved it so much that he ate three! At midnight, he had to go home. Before he left, he asked for some seeds. "I want to {5} them on my planet," he said. Now, every time I look at the stars, I wonder if there are mango trees on Planet Zork.

blanks.why: 外星人很餓 hungry，所以帶他去廚房開冰箱。wooden（木製的）、national（國家的）、illegal（違法的）都不能說明為什麼要找東西吃。
給他一顆番茄 tomato，他問「這是紅色小星球嗎？」然後一口吃掉。ticket（票）、pocket（口袋）、letter（信）都不是紅色圓圓、可以吃的東西。
他吃了一些豆子 beans，不喜歡而做鬼臉。offices（辦公室）、villages（村莊）、museums（博物館）都不能吃。
黃色的芒果 mango，他愛到吃了三顆。uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）、factory（工廠）都不能吃。
plant seeds「種下種子」。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、pray（禱告）接 them（種子）都不通。

passages.zh: 有天晚上，一個綠色的小外星人降落在我家後院。他叫 Zork，肚子非常餓。我帶他到廚房，打開冰箱。我先給他一顆番茄，他把番茄舉起來問：「這是一顆紅色的小星球嗎？」然後一口吃掉，笑了。接著他吃了一些豆子，他不喜歡，做了個好笑的鬼臉。然後我給他一顆黃色的芒果，他愛得不得了，一口氣吃了三顆！半夜時，他得回家了。離開前，他跟我要了一些種子。「我想把它們種在我的星球上。」他說。現在每次看星星，我都會想，Zork 星球上是不是長出了芒果樹。

passages.title: 灰姑娘的紙南瓜
passages.text: Our class performed Cinderella at the school festival, and I was the fairy godmother. In the most famous scene, I turn a big orange {1} into a carriage. We didn't have a real one, so we made it from paper and painted it orange. On the day of the show, I was very {2} because my parents were watching. When I waved my magic stick, the lights went off, and two classmates quickly pushed out the carriage. The audience {3}. But then my classmate Ben, who played a mouse, tripped and fell into the carriage! Everyone laughed. After the show, our teacher gave us a real pumpkin pie and a box of {4} as a prize. Ben said, "Next year, I want to be the {5}, not the mouse. It doesn't have to move!"

blanks.why: 把一顆大橘色南瓜 pumpkin 變成馬車，這是灰姑娘最有名的一幕。pocket（口袋）、ticket（票）、letter（信）都不是橘色的大東西，也不是故事裡變成馬車的東西。
爸媽在台下看，所以很緊張 nervous。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的心情。
馬車推出來，觀眾歡呼 cheered。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、borrowed（借）都不是觀眾看表演的反應。
a box of strawberries「一盒草莓」當獎品。offices（辦公室）、villages（村莊）、museums（博物館）都不可能裝進盒子裡。
Ben 想演南瓜 pumpkin，因為南瓜不用動。village（村莊）、museum（博物館）、factory（工廠）都不是灰姑娘劇裡的角色。

passages.zh: 我們班在校慶表演《灰姑娘》，我演神仙教母。在最有名的那一幕，我要把一顆大大的橘色南瓜變成馬車。我們沒有真的南瓜，所以用紙做了一顆，再漆成橘色。表演當天，因為爸媽在台下看，我非常緊張。我揮動魔杖，燈光一暗，兩個同學很快把馬車推出來，觀眾都歡呼起來。可是演老鼠的同學 Ben 一個踉蹌，跌進了馬車裡！大家都笑翻了。表演結束後，老師送我們一個真的南瓜派和一盒草莓當獎品。Ben 說：「明年我要演南瓜，不要演老鼠了。南瓜都不用動！」

passages.title: 愛吃草莓的柴犬
passages.text: My dog, Mochi, is a white Shiba Inu. Her favorite snack is {1}. Whenever she hears me open the fridge, she runs into the kitchen and waits. One day, I wanted to find out what other fruit she liked. I put a piece of {2}, a grape, and a small {3} in front of her. She ate the mango right away, but she only smelled the tomato and walked away. Later, the vet told me that dogs should never eat grapes, so I was {4} she didn't touch it! Now I only give her safe snacks, like boiled {5} and carrots. She seems to love them all, and she still runs to the fridge every time.

blanks.why: 牠最愛的點心是草莓 strawberries，所以一開冰箱就跑來。tickets（票）、pockets（口袋）、offices（辦公室）都不是點心。
a piece of mango「一塊芒果」，下一句說牠馬上把芒果吃掉。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不是要測試狗狗喜不喜歡的水果。
一顆小番茄 tomato，下一句說牠只聞了聞番茄就走開。letter（信）、uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）都不是食物。
狗不能吃葡萄，牠沒碰葡萄，所以我很幸運 lucky。wooden（木製的）、thick（厚的）、national（國家的）都不能放在 I was … 表示心情或運氣。
boiled pumpkin「煮過的南瓜」是安全的點心。homework（功課）、traffic（交通）、garbage（垃圾）都不能給狗吃。

passages.zh: 我的狗 Mochi 是一隻白色柴犬，牠最愛的點心是草莓。只要聽到我開冰箱，牠就會衝進廚房等著。有一天，我想知道牠還喜歡什麼水果，就在牠面前放了一塊芒果、一顆葡萄和一顆小番茄。牠馬上把芒果吃掉，番茄卻只聞了聞就走開。後來獸醫告訴我，狗絕對不能吃葡萄，所以還好牠沒碰！現在我只給牠安全的點心，像是煮過的南瓜和紅蘿蔔。牠好像每一樣都很愛，而且每次開冰箱還是會跑過來。

passages.title: 士林夜市的糖葫蘆
passages.text: On Saturday night, my best friend Amy and I went to the Shilin Night Market. There were so many people that it was very {1}. Amy wanted to try tanghulu, the shiny candy fruit on a stick. We found a shop that sold many kinds. There were sticks of {2}, grapes, and even small cherry {3}! I chose a tomato one because I was {4} about the taste. It was sweet and a little sour. Amy chose strawberry, but she bit too hard, and the candy broke into pieces. Some of them fell on her shirt, and we laughed so hard. On the way home, we bought a cup of fresh {5} juice to share.

blanks.why: 人太多，所以很擁擠 crowded。honest（誠實的）、lazy（懶惰的）、polite（有禮貌的）都是形容人的，不能形容地方。
一串串的草莓 strawberries 糖葫蘆。tickets（票）、offices（辦公室）、uniforms（制服）都不能做成糖葫蘆。
cherry tomatoes「小番茄」，後面說我選了番茄口味。letters（信）、pockets（口袋）、museums（博物館）都不能串起來吃。
be curious about…「對…感到好奇」，想知道味道。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 about the taste 表示心情。
mango juice「芒果汁」。weather（天氣）、traffic（交通）、homework（功課）都不能做成果汁。

passages.zh: 星期六晚上，我和好朋友 Amy 去士林夜市。人多到非常擁擠。Amy 想吃糖葫蘆，就是插在竹籤上、亮晶晶的糖衣水果。我們找到一家賣很多種口味的店，有草莓、葡萄，甚至還有小番茄！我很好奇番茄是什麼味道，所以選了番茄口味，吃起來甜甜的、帶點酸。Amy 選了草莓，但她咬得太用力，糖衣碎成好幾塊，有些還掉到她衣服上，我們笑到不行。回家路上，我們買了一杯新鮮芒果汁一起喝。

passages.title: 教練的芒果冰承諾
passages.text: Our school basketball team had a big game against Ren-Ai Junior High last Friday. Before the game, our coach made a promise: "If we win, I'll buy everyone a bowl of {1} ice." We were all excited. But in the first half, we played badly and were behind by ten points. In the locker room, the coach said, "Don't {2} up. Think about the mangoes!" Everyone laughed, and we felt more {3}. In the second half, our captain made three shots in a row, and we won by two points! The coach kept his promise. At the ice shop, the team ate twelve bowls of mango ice and three bowls of {4} ice. Even the coach ate two. "Next time," he said, "I'll promise something cheaper, like {5}."

blanks.why: a bowl of mango ice「一碗芒果冰」，後面教練說「想想芒果」。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能做成冰給球員吃。
give up「放棄」，教練在落後時鼓勵大家不要放棄。spell、pray、marry 都不能和 up 組成「放棄」的意思。
大家笑了以後覺得更有信心 more confident，下半場就反敗為勝。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容球員的心情。
strawberry ice「草莓冰」，和芒果冰一樣是冰店賣的。ticket（票）、uniform（制服）、office（辦公室）都不是冰的口味。
教練開玩笑說下次只請便宜的東西，像是番茄 tomatoes。factories（工廠）、museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）都一點也不便宜，也不能請球員吃。

passages.zh: 上星期五，我們學校籃球隊和仁愛國中有一場大比賽。賽前教練許下承諾：「如果贏了，我請大家每人吃一碗芒果冰。」大家都好興奮。可是上半場我們打得很差，落後十分。在休息室裡，教練說：「不要放棄，想想芒果！」大家都笑了，也覺得比較有信心了。下半場，我們隊長連進三球，最後我們贏了兩分！教練遵守承諾。在冰店裡，全隊吃了十二碗芒果冰和三碗草莓冰，連教練都吃了兩碗。「下次，」他說，「我要承諾便宜一點的東西，像是番茄。」

passages.title: 西班牙番茄大戰
passages.text: Last August, my family traveled to Spain. We went to a small town called Buñol for a very special festival, La Tomatina. Every year, thousands of people come there to throw {1} at each other! Before it started, my dad told us to {2} old clothes and goggles. At eleven o'clock, trucks drove into the streets and dropped tons of soft, red {3}. Then the fight began. People threw them everywhere, and soon the whole street looked like a river of soup. I was hit in the face many times, but it was really {4}. After one hour, the fight ended, and firefighters washed the streets with water. That night, we were all very hungry. We had paella, a Spanish rice dish with chicken and {5}. Of course, we didn't want to eat any tomatoes!

blanks.why: 番茄大戰就是互丟番茄 tomatoes。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不是這個節慶丟的東西，offices 更不可能丟。
wear old clothes「穿舊衣服」，以免被番茄弄髒。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、pray（禱告）都不能接 clothes and goggles。
卡車倒下好幾噸軟軟的紅番茄 tomatoes，接著大戰開始。uniforms（制服）、bills（帳單）、museums（博物館）都不會是「軟軟紅紅」、可以丟的東西。
雖然臉被打中很多次，但真的很刺激 exciting。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、lazy（懶惰的）都不能形容活動本身。
西班牙海鮮飯裡有雞肉和豆子 beans。museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）、factories（工廠）都不能當飯的材料。

passages.zh: 去年八月，我們全家去西班牙旅行。我們到一個叫布尼奧爾的小鎮，參加一個非常特別的節慶——番茄大戰。每年都有成千上萬的人來這裡互丟番茄！開始前，爸爸叫我們穿舊衣服、戴護目鏡。十一點一到，卡車開進街道，倒下好幾噸又軟又紅的番茄，大戰就開始了。大家到處亂丟，整條街很快就像一條湯河。我的臉被打中好多次，但真的很刺激。一個小時後大戰結束，消防員用水把街道沖乾淨。那天晚上大家都很餓，我們吃了西班牙燉飯，裡面有雞肉和豆子。當然，我們一顆番茄都不想吃了！

passages.title: 當個創世神的南瓜農場
passages.text: My little brother and I love playing Minecraft together. Last weekend, we decided to build a big farm in the game. First, we found a flat place near a river and {1} some seeds. We grew wheat, carrots, and orange {2}. My brother used two snow blocks and a pumpkin to make a snow golem. "It will {3} our farm from monsters at night," he said. We also found cocoa {4} in the jungle and used them to make cookies. At the end of the day, my brother made a {5} pie and gave it to me in the game. "It looks delicious, but I can't eat it," I said. So the next day, Mom baked us a real one.

blanks.why: planted some seeds「種下一些種子」，後面說種了小麥、紅蘿蔔和南瓜。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、prayed（禱告）接 seeds 都不通。
orange pumpkins「橘色的南瓜」，和小麥、紅蘿蔔一樣是種出來的作物。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不能種。
protect…from…「保護…免於…」，雪人晚上保護農場不被怪物攻擊。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、pray（禱告）都不能接 our farm from monsters。
cocoa beans「可可豆」，可以做餅乾。uniforms（制服）、bills（帳單）、museums（博物館）都不會在叢林裡找到，也不能做餅乾。
pumpkin pie「南瓜派」，後面媽媽烤了一個真的。homework（功課）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能做成派。

passages.zh: 我和弟弟很喜歡一起玩《當個創世神》。上週末，我們決定在遊戲裡蓋一座大農場。首先，我們在河邊找到一塊平地，種下一些種子，種了小麥、紅蘿蔔和橘色的南瓜。弟弟用兩塊雪和一顆南瓜做了一個雪人。「晚上它會保護我們的農場，不讓怪物靠近。」他說。我們還在叢林裡找到可可豆，拿來做餅乾。那天快結束時，弟弟在遊戲裡做了一個南瓜派送給我。「看起來好好吃，可是我不能吃。」我說。所以第二天，媽媽烤了一個真的給我們。

passages.title: 會摘草莓的機器人
passages.text: Have you ever seen a robot farmer? Last month, I visited a high-tech farm in Hsinchu with my science class. Inside a big greenhouse, there were long rows of {1} growing on tables, not on the ground. A small robot moved slowly between them. It used a camera to {2} the color of each strawberry. If one was red enough, the robot picked it with its soft fingers. The farmer said, "The robot can work all night, and it never feels {3}." He also showed us a machine that grows {4} with only water and light, without any soil. At the end of the visit, we each got a box of strawberries and cherry {5}. On the bus, my friend said, "When I grow up, I'll make a robot that does my homework."

blanks.why: 溫室裡一排排長在桌上的草莓 strawberries。offices（辦公室）、museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）都不會「長」在桌上。
用相機檢查 check 每顆草莓的顏色。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、pray（禱告）都不能接 the color。
機器人整晚工作也不會累 tired。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能接在 feels 後面表示感覺。
只用水和光就能種番茄 tomatoes 的機器。tickets（票）、letters（信）、pockets（口袋）都不能種出來。
cherry tomatoes「小番茄」，和草莓一起裝盒帶回家。uniforms（制服）、bills（帳單）、factories（工廠）都不是農場送的農產品。

passages.zh: 你看過機器人農夫嗎？上個月，我和自然課的同學去參觀新竹一座高科技農場。大溫室裡有一排排草莓，種在桌上而不是地上。一台小機器人在中間慢慢移動，用相機檢查每顆草莓的顏色，如果夠紅，就用軟軟的手指把它摘下來。農夫說：「機器人可以整晚工作，而且從來不會累。」他還帶我們看一台只用水和光、不用土就能種番茄的機器。參觀結束時，我們每人拿到一盒草莓和小番茄。在遊覽車上，我朋友說：「我長大要做一台會幫我寫功課的機器人。」

passages.title: 數學展的猜豆子遊戲
passages.text: At our school's math fair, there was a big glass jar full of red {1} on a table. The game was simple: guess how many there were, and the closest {2} wins a prize. My friend Ken just wrote "1,000" without thinking. But I wanted to {3} it like a math problem. First, I measured the jar. Then I counted how many beans could fit in a small cup and did some math. In the end, I guessed 2,350. The real number was 2,412, and nobody was closer than me! I won first prize: a big basket of {4} and {5}. I shared them with Ken, and he said, "Okay, math really is useful."

blanks.why: 玻璃罐裡裝滿紅豆 red beans，後面在數豆子。offices（辦公室）、villages（村莊）、museums（博物館）都裝不進玻璃罐。
the closest guess wins「猜得最接近的人獲勝」，guess 在這裡是名詞「猜測」。uniform（制服）、garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）都和猜數字無關。
solve it like a math problem「像解數學題一樣解決它」。marry（結婚）、pray（禱告）、spell（拼字）都不能接 like a math problem 表示解題。
一大籃芒果 mangoes 當獎品，後面說和 Ken 分享。tickets（票）、letters（信）、bills（帳單）都不會裝一大籃當水果獎品，也不能吃。
芒果和草莓 strawberries 一起裝在籃子裡。pockets（口袋）、corners（角落）、offices（辦公室）都不能放進籃子。

passages.zh: 在我們學校的數學展上，桌上放著一個裝滿紅豆的大玻璃罐。遊戲很簡單：猜罐子裡有幾顆，猜得最接近的人就能得獎。我朋友 Ken 想都沒想就寫了「1,000」。但我想把它當成數學題來解。首先，我量了罐子的大小，然後數一個小杯子能裝幾顆豆子，再算一算。最後我猜 2,350。正確答案是 2,412，沒有人比我更接近！我得到第一名，獎品是一大籃芒果和草莓。我分給 Ken 吃，他說：「好吧，數學真的很有用。」

passages.title: 寄給大阪筆友的芒果乾
passages.text: I have a pen pal in Osaka named Yuki. We write letters to each other every month. Last month, she sent me some Japanese snacks, so this time I wanted to send her something from Taiwan. I chose dried {1} from Tainan because it's sweet and very {2}. I also put in a small bag of dried {3}. In my letter, I wrote, "Mangoes are everywhere in southern Taiwan in summer. They're cheap and delicious." Two weeks later, Yuki {4} me a photo of her family eating the snacks. "My family ate everything in one night!" she wrote. "In Japan, one {5} can cost 3,000 yen!" Now I know what to send her next year.

blanks.why: dried mango「芒果乾」，台南的名產。weather（天氣）、traffic（交通）、homework（功課）都不能寄給朋友當零食。
芒果乾又甜又有名 famous。wooden（木製的）、thick（厚的）、illegal（違法的）都不是挑選它當禮物的好理由。
a small bag of dried strawberries「一小袋草莓乾」。offices（辦公室）、villages（村莊）、factories（工廠）都裝不進小袋子。
sent me a photo「寄了一張照片給我」。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、prayed（禱告）都不能接 me a photo。
在日本一顆芒果 mango 可能要三千日圓。museum（博物館）、village（村莊）、factory（工廠）的價錢不會是三千日圓，也和寄零食無關。

passages.zh: 我有一個住在大阪的筆友，叫 Yuki。我們每個月互相寫信。上個月她寄了一些日本零食給我，所以這次我想寄台灣的東西給她。我選了台南的芒果乾，因為又甜又很有名。我還放了一小袋草莓乾。我在信裡寫：「夏天的台灣南部到處都是芒果，又便宜又好吃。」兩個星期後，Yuki 寄來一張她全家吃零食的照片。「我們家一個晚上就全部吃光了！」她寫道，「在日本，一顆芒果可能要三千日圓！」現在我知道明年要寄什麼給她了。

passages.title: 夢遊霍格華茲
passages.text: Last night, I had a strange dream. I got a letter from Hogwarts, the school of magic in Harry Potter! An owl took me to the castle, and I sat at a long table in the Great Hall next to Harry, Ron, and Hermione. Food appeared on the table by magic. There was roast chicken, potatoes, and green {1}. Ron gave me a cup of cold {2} juice. It tasted sweet and a little strange. After dinner, we had a class with Professor Sprout. She taught us how to grow a magic {3} that could sing. Mine sang so loudly that everyone {4}. Then my alarm clock rang, and I woke up. I was so {5}. I wanted to stay at Hogwarts forever!

blanks.why: 桌上的食物有烤雞、馬鈴薯和四季豆 green beans。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不是晚餐的菜。
pumpkin juice「南瓜汁」，喝起來甜甜怪怪的。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能做成果汁。
種一顆會唱歌的魔法番茄 tomato。pocket（口袋）、uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）都不能「種」出來。
番茄唱得太大聲，大家都笑了 laughed。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、borrowed（借）都不是聽到好笑的事的反應。
從美夢醒來，很失望 disappointed，因為想一直待在霍格華茲。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容心情。

passages.zh: 昨晚我做了一個奇怪的夢。我收到一封霍格華茲寄來的信，就是《哈利波特》裡的魔法學校！一隻貓頭鷹帶我到城堡，我在大廳的長桌旁坐下，旁邊是哈利、榮恩和妙麗。食物用魔法出現在桌上，有烤雞、馬鈴薯和四季豆。榮恩給我一杯冰涼的南瓜汁，喝起來甜甜的，又有點怪。晚餐後，我們上了芽菜教授的課，她教我們種一顆會唱歌的魔法番茄。我的番茄唱得超大聲，大家都笑了。然後鬧鐘響了，我醒了過來。我好失望，我想永遠待在霍格華茲！

passages.title: 生日蛋糕惹的禍
passages.text: Last Saturday was my birthday, and Mom bought a big cake covered with {1}. I happily ate two pieces. But an hour later, my face turned red, my lips got bigger, and I felt very {2}. Mom quickly took me to the hospital. The doctor said I was allergic to strawberries. He gave me some {3}, and after a few hours, I felt much better. I was sad because strawberries were my favorite fruit. But Mom hugged me and said, "Don't worry. Next year, I'll make you a {4} cake instead." Grandma said she would bake a {5} pie for me, too. Now I'm a little excited about my next birthday.

blanks.why: 蛋糕上鋪滿草莓 strawberries，後面醫生說我對草莓過敏。tickets（票）、offices（辦公室）、letters（信）都不能鋪在蛋糕上吃。
過敏時臉紅、嘴唇腫、覺得頭暈 dizzy。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容身體不舒服。
醫生給我一些藥 medicine，吃了就好多了。homework（功課）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不是醫生會給的東西。
明年改做芒果 mango 蛋糕，代替不能吃的草莓。museum（博物館）、village（村莊）、factory（工廠）都不能做成蛋糕。
pumpkin pie「南瓜派」。uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）、pocket（口袋）都不能烤成派。

passages.zh: 上星期六是我的生日，媽媽買了一個鋪滿草莓的大蛋糕。我開開心心吃了兩塊。但一個小時後，我的臉變紅、嘴唇腫起來，還覺得很頭暈。媽媽趕快帶我去醫院，醫生說我對草莓過敏。他給我一些藥，幾個小時後我就好多了。我很難過，因為草莓是我最愛的水果。但媽媽抱著我說：「別擔心，明年我改做芒果蛋糕給你。」奶奶也說要烤一個南瓜派給我。現在我對下一次生日有點期待了。

passages.title: 番茄醬的小故事
passages.text: Do you like ketchup on your French fries? Today, most ketchup is made from {1}, but long ago it wasn't. The first ketchup came from Asia, and it was made from fish! In the 1800s, Americans started to make it with tomatoes. But at first, many people thought tomatoes were {2} to eat because the plant looked like some poisonous plants. Later, people learned that a {3} is safe and delicious. Then a company started to {4} ketchup in clear glass bottles, so people could see that it was clean. Soon, ketchup became popular all over the world. Today, people put it on eggs, hot dogs, and even {5}. Which food do you like to eat with ketchup?

blanks.why: 番茄醬是用番茄 tomatoes 做的，後面也說美國人開始用番茄來做。tickets（票）、pockets（口袋）、offices（辦公室）都不能做醬。
以前人們認為番茄吃了很危險 dangerous，因為長得像有毒植物。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、lazy（懶惰的）都是形容人的，不能接 to eat。
後來人們知道番茄 tomato 安全又好吃。ticket（票）、letter（信）、bill（帳單）都不能用 delicious 形容。
start to sell ketchup「開始賣番茄醬」，用透明瓶子讓人看到很乾淨。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、pray（禱告）都不能接 ketchup in bottles。
番茄醬可以加在蛋、熱狗，甚至豆子 beans 上。museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）、factories（工廠）都不是食物。

passages.zh: 你喜歡在薯條上加番茄醬嗎？現在大部分的番茄醬是用番茄做的，但很久以前並不是。最早的番茄醬來自亞洲，竟然是用魚做的！到了 1800 年代，美國人開始用番茄來做。不過一開始，很多人認為吃番茄很危險，因為番茄的植株長得像一些有毒植物。後來人們才知道番茄既安全又好吃。接著有一家公司開始用透明玻璃瓶賣番茄醬，讓大家看得到它很乾淨。很快地，番茄醬就紅遍全世界。現在，人們把它加在蛋、熱狗上，甚至加在豆子上。你喜歡用番茄醬配什麼食物呢？

passages.title: 颱風過後的番茄園
passages.text: My grandpa has a small farm in Yunlin. He grows {1}, green {2}, and a few pumpkins. Last September, a strong typhoon hit Taiwan. The wind blew down most of his plants. When we visited him after the storm, he looked very {3}. "Almost all my tomatoes are gone," he said quietly. My dad and I decided to help him. We picked up the plants that weren't broken and tied them to sticks. We also {4} up the mud and leaves on the ground. It took us two whole days. A month later, Grandpa sent us a box of tomatoes and a big {5} with a note: "Thank you. These are from the plants you saved."

blanks.why: 爺爺的農場種番茄 tomatoes，後面說番茄幾乎都沒了。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不能種在農場裡。
green beans「四季豆」，也是農場種的作物。pockets（口袋）、uniforms（制服）、bills（帳單）都不能種。
作物被颱風吹倒，爺爺看起來很難過 sad。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能接在 looked very 後面形容心情。
clean up the mud「把泥巴清乾淨」。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、prayed（禱告）都不能和 up 接 the mud。
寄來一箱番茄和一顆大南瓜 pumpkin，前面提過農場種了南瓜。museum（博物館）、village（村莊）、factory（工廠）都不能裝箱寄送。

passages.zh: 我爺爺在雲林有一塊小農地，種了番茄、四季豆和幾顆南瓜。去年九月，一個強烈颱風侵襲台灣，大風把他大部分的作物都吹倒了。颱風過後我們去看他，他看起來很難過。「我的番茄幾乎全沒了。」他小聲地說。爸爸和我決定幫忙。我們把沒斷掉的植株扶起來，綁在竹竿上，也把地上的泥巴和落葉清乾淨，整整花了兩天。一個月後，爺爺寄給我們一箱番茄和一顆大南瓜，還附了一張字條：「謝謝你們，這些是你們救回來的植物長出來的。」

passages.title: 坐在南瓜裡划船
passages.text: Have you ever seen people sit in a {1} and use it as a boat? In some towns in Canada and the U.S., farmers grow giant pumpkins that weigh more than 500 kilograms. Every October, they hold a special race. People cut a big hole in the top, take out the inside, and sit in it. Then they try to {2} a lake as fast as they can. Last year, my uncle in Canada joined the race. "It was harder than I thought," he said. "My pumpkin kept turning in circles!" He finished last, but he wasn't {3} at all because everyone laughed and cheered for him. After the race, the town used the pumpkins to cook a giant pot of {4} soup. People ate it with bread and baked {5}.

blanks.why: 坐在南瓜 pumpkin 裡當船，後面說農夫種出超過 500 公斤的大南瓜。pocket（口袋）、ticket（票）、letter（信）都不可能坐進去當船。
cross a lake「渡過湖」，用南瓜船比賽。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、pray（禱告）都不能接 a lake。
雖然最後一名，但一點也不難過 not upset，因為大家都在歡呼。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能形容人的心情。
用南瓜煮一大鍋南瓜湯 pumpkin soup。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能煮成湯。
baked beans「焗豆」，配麵包吃。museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）、factories（工廠）都不能吃。

passages.zh: 你看過有人坐在南瓜裡、把它當船划嗎？在加拿大和美國的一些小鎮，農夫會種出超過 500 公斤的巨大南瓜。每年十月，他們會舉辦一場特別的比賽：大家在南瓜頂端切一個大洞，把裡面挖空，然後坐進去，盡快划過一座湖。去年，我住在加拿大的叔叔也參加了。「比我想的還難，」他說，「我的南瓜一直在原地轉圈圈！」他最後一名，但一點也不難過，因為大家都笑著為他加油。比賽結束後，鎮上用那些南瓜煮了一大鍋南瓜湯，大家配著麵包和焗豆一起吃。

passages.title: 營養午餐的四季豆
passages.text: At our school, everyone eats the same lunch. Last Tuesday, we had fried rice, soup, and green {1}. My classmate Leo hates them. He tried to {2} them under his rice, but our teacher saw him. "Leo, you should eat some vegetables. They're good for your {3}," she said. Leo ate one bean and made a sad face. Then our class leader had an idea. "Let's have a contest. If everyone finishes their vegetables every day this month, we'll have a fruit party with {4} and {5}!" Leo really loves fruit, so he started eating his beans, one by one. At the end of the month, our class had the party. Now Leo says, "Beans aren't so bad after all."

blanks.why: green beans「四季豆」，後面說 Leo 只吃了一根豆子。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不是午餐的菜。
hide them under his rice「把它們藏在飯底下」。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、pray（禱告）都不能接 them under his rice。
be good for your health「對健康有益」。homework（功課）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都和吃青菜的好處無關。
水果派對上有芒果 mangoes。uniforms（制服）、bills（帳單）、museums（博物館）都不是水果。
芒果和草莓 strawberries 一起當派對水果。pockets（口袋）、corners（角落）、factories（工廠）都不能吃。

passages.zh: 在我們學校，大家吃一樣的營養午餐。上星期二的菜是炒飯、湯和四季豆。我同學 Leo 討厭四季豆。他想把豆子藏在飯底下，但被老師看到了。「Leo，你應該吃點青菜，對健康很好。」老師說。Leo 吃了一根，露出難過的表情。這時班長想到一個點子：「我們來比賽吧！如果這個月每個人每天都把青菜吃完，我們就辦一場有芒果和草莓的水果派對！」Leo 超愛水果，所以開始一根一根地吃四季豆。到了月底，我們班真的辦了派對。現在 Leo 說：「四季豆其實也沒那麼糟嘛。」

passages.title: 母親節的南瓜鬆餅
passages.text: On Mother's Day, my sister and I wanted to surprise Mom with breakfast in bed. We got up at six so that she wouldn't {1}. We made pancakes and cut some {2} and a {3} to put on top. But I used too much flour, and the first pancake was as hard as a rock. My sister laughed so loudly that she woke Mom up! Mom came into the kitchen and saw flour everywhere. She wasn't angry at all. Instead, she smiled and helped us make new ones. She showed us how to mix some cooked {4} into the batter to make the pancakes soft and sweet. In the end, we ate breakfast together at the table, not in bed. Mom said it was the best Mother's Day {5} ever.

blanks.why: so that she wouldn't notice「這樣她才不會發現」，因為要給媽媽驚喜。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、boil（煮沸）都和「不被發現」無關。
切一些草莓 strawberries 放在鬆餅上。tickets（票）、offices（辦公室）、letters（信）都不能切來放在鬆餅上。
切一顆芒果 mango 當配料。museum（博物館）、village（村莊）、factory（工廠）都不能切、也不能吃。
把煮熟的南瓜 pumpkin 拌進麵糊，讓鬆餅又軟又甜。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能加進麵糊。
the best Mother's Day gift「最棒的母親節禮物」。uniform（制服）、corner（角落）、bill（帳單）都不能用來形容我們為媽媽做的這份心意。

passages.zh: 母親節那天，我和妹妹想給媽媽一個驚喜：讓她在床上吃早餐。我們六點就起床，這樣她才不會發現。我們做了鬆餅，還切了一些草莓和一顆芒果要放在上面。可是我麵粉放太多，第一片鬆餅硬得像石頭。妹妹笑得太大聲，把媽媽吵醒了！媽媽走進廚房，看到到處都是麵粉，她一點也沒生氣，反而笑著幫我們重做。她教我們把一些煮熟的南瓜拌進麵糊裡，讓鬆餅又軟又甜。最後，我們是在餐桌旁一起吃早餐，而不是在床上。媽媽說這是她收過最棒的母親節禮物。

passages.title: 愛喊芒果的鸚鵡
passages.text: My aunt has a green parrot named Lucky. He's very {1} and can say about thirty words. His favorite word is "Mango!" because mango is his favorite {2}. Every morning, he shouts, "Mango! Mango!" until my aunt gives him a piece. Last summer, I stayed at my aunt's house for a week. One night, I ate the last {3} in the fridge without asking. The next morning, Lucky looked at the empty fridge and then at me. He shouted, "Bad boy! Bad boy!" all day long. To say sorry, I bought him a box of {4} and some cooked {5}. He ate them all, but then he looked at me and said, "Mango?" My aunt laughed so hard.

blanks.why: 會說三十個字，表示很聰明 smart。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能說明牠為什麼會說很多字。
芒果是牠最愛的水果 fruit。homework（功課）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能用 mango 來舉例。
吃掉冰箱裡最後一顆芒果 mango，所以鸚鵡生氣。ticket（票）、letter（信）、uniform（制服）都不會放在冰箱裡吃。
a box of strawberries「一盒草莓」，買來向鸚鵡道歉。offices（辦公室）、museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）都裝不進盒子。
cooked beans「煮熟的豆子」，鸚鵡把它們吃光。corners（角落）、factories（工廠）、bills（帳單）都不能吃。

passages.zh: 我阿姨養了一隻綠色鸚鵡叫 Lucky。牠很聰明，會說大約三十個字。牠最愛說的字是「芒果！」，因為芒果是牠最愛的水果。每天早上，牠都會大喊「芒果！芒果！」，直到阿姨給牠一塊。去年夏天，我在阿姨家住了一個星期。有天晚上，我沒問就吃掉了冰箱裡最後一顆芒果。隔天早上，Lucky 看看空空的冰箱，又看看我，然後整天大喊：「壞孩子！壞孩子！」為了道歉，我買了一盒草莓和一些煮熟的豆子給牠。牠全部吃光了，接著看著我說：「芒果？」阿姨笑到不行。

passages.title: 菜園小鎮的選舉
passages.text: In a garden far away, the vegetables lived together in a little town. Every year, they chose a new leader. This year, there were two choices. The {1} was red, shiny, and very {2}. He gave great speeches and promised, "I'll bring more sunshine to everyone!" The {3} was big, round, and quiet. She said, "When it rains, the little ones can stay under my big leaves." Most people thought the tomato would win. But on the day of the election, it rained very hard, and the pumpkin kept all the small {4} dry under her leaves. The next day, the beans all chose the pumpkin. The tomato was {5}, but he shook her leaf and said, "You'll be a great leader."

blanks.why: the tomato「番茄」又紅又亮，是候選人之一。ticket（票）、pocket（口袋）、letter（信）都不是菜園小鎮的居民。
長得紅潤發亮，很帥 handsome，又會演講。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不是在稱讚候選人的外表。
the pumpkin「南瓜」又大又圓、有大葉子，是另一位候選人。uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）、corner（角落）都不會有葉子。
南瓜用葉子幫小豆子 beans 遮雨，後來豆子們都選她。offices（辦公室）、museums（博物館）、factories（工廠）都不是菜園裡的居民。
番茄輸了很失望 disappointed，但還是祝福南瓜。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、national（國家的）都不能形容落選的心情。

passages.zh: 在很遠的一座菜園裡，蔬菜們一起住在一個小鎮上，每年都會選出一位新領袖。今年有兩位候選人。番茄又紅又亮，長得非常帥，他很會演講，還承諾：「我會給大家更多陽光！」南瓜又大又圓，話不多。她說：「下雨的時候，小傢伙們可以躲在我的大葉子底下。」大部分的人都以為番茄會贏。可是選舉當天下了一場大雨，南瓜用葉子讓所有小豆子都沒淋濕。第二天，豆子們全都投給了南瓜。番茄很失望，但還是握了握她的葉子說：「妳會是一位很棒的領袖。」

passages.title: 太聰明的智慧冰箱
passages.text: Last month, my dad bought a smart fridge. It has a camera inside and a screen on the door, so it knows what food we have and when it will go bad. One day, the fridge said, "Your {1} will go bad in two days. Please eat them soon." So Mom made tomato soup that night. The next week, it said, "You have no more {2}. Do you want to order some online?" My little sister said yes and ordered fifty boxes by mistake! Dad had to {3} the store to stop the order. The fridge even told Dad to eat more {4} and less meat. Dad shook his head and said, "This fridge is too {5}. Now it sounds just like your mom!"

blanks.why: 冰箱提醒番茄 tomatoes 快壞了，媽媽就煮了番茄湯。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不會「壞掉」，也不能煮湯。
沒有草莓 strawberries 了，問要不要上網訂，後面妹妹訂了五十盒。uniforms（制服）、bills（帳單）、museums（博物館）都不會放在冰箱裡。
call the store「打電話給商店」取消訂單。spell（拼字）、marry（結婚）、boil（煮沸）都不能接 the store 表示聯絡。
多吃豆子 beans、少吃肉，是健康飲食的建議。factories（工廠）、villages（村莊）、corners（角落）都不能吃。
冰箱太聰明 smart 了，會管人吃什麼。wooden（木製的）、thick（厚的）、national（國家的）都不能說明冰箱會說話、會提醒。

passages.zh: 上個月，爸爸買了一台智慧冰箱。它裡面有相機，門上有螢幕，所以知道我們有哪些食物、什麼時候會壞掉。有一天，冰箱說：「您的番茄兩天後會壞掉，請盡快食用。」所以那天晚上媽媽煮了番茄湯。下個星期，它說：「草莓已經沒有了，要上網訂購嗎？」妹妹說要，結果不小心訂了五十盒！爸爸只好打電話給商店取消訂單。冰箱甚至叫爸爸多吃豆子、少吃肉。爸爸搖搖頭說：「這台冰箱太聰明了，現在講話跟你媽媽一模一樣！」

passages.title: 曼谷的芒果糯米飯
passages.text: During winter vacation, my family went to Bangkok, Thailand. The weather was hot, and the streets were full of cars and motorcycles. It was very {1}. On our first night, we visited a night market. Mom wanted to try mango sticky rice, a famous Thai dessert. The seller put warm sticky rice on a plate, added slices of yellow {2}, and poured coconut milk on top. It was so good that I ordered another plate. I also tried a spicy salad made with green papaya, {3}, and long {4}. It was so spicy that I had to drink three glasses of water! On our last day, I bought ten bags of dried {5} for my classmates in Taiwan.

blanks.why: 街上滿是汽機車，所以很吵 noisy。honest（誠實的）、polite（有禮貌的）、lazy（懶惰的）都是形容人的，不能形容街道。
糯米飯上放幾片黃色芒果 mango，就是芒果糯米飯。uniform（制服）、bill（帳單）、ticket（票）都不能切片放在甜點上。
木瓜沙拉裡有番茄 tomatoes。pockets（口袋）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不能做成沙拉。
long beans「長豆、豇豆」，也是沙拉的材料。museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）、factories（工廠）都不能吃。
dried mango「芒果乾」，買來送同學。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能裝袋送人。

passages.zh: 寒假時，我們全家去泰國曼谷玩。天氣很熱，街上滿是汽車和機車，非常吵。第一天晚上，我們去逛夜市。媽媽想吃芒果糯米飯，那是很有名的泰國甜點。老闆把溫熱的糯米飯放在盤子上，加上幾片黃色芒果，再淋上椰奶。好吃到我又點了一盤。我還吃了一道辣的青木瓜沙拉，裡面有番茄和長豆，辣到我得喝三杯水！最後一天，我買了十袋芒果乾要送給台灣的同學。

passages.title: 草莓失蹤事件
passages.text: On Sunday morning, Mom opened the fridge and found that the box of {1} was empty. "Who ate them?" she asked. Nobody said anything. My little brother loves detective cartoons like Detective Conan. "I'll {2} this case!" he said. First, he found red juice on Dad's shirt. But Dad said it came from a {3} he ate at breakfast. Next, my brother looked at our cat, Momo, but cats don't eat strawberries. Then he {4} the trash can and found some strawberry leaves. Under them was a piece of paper from Grandma's notebook! Grandma laughed. "Okay, it was me. I used them to make a cake with {5} for your birthday tomorrow. It was supposed to be a surprise!"

blanks.why: 冰箱裡那盒草莓 strawberries 空了，後面說找到草莓蒂頭。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不會放在冰箱裡被吃掉。
solve this case「破這個案子」。marry（結婚）、spell（拼字）、pray（禱告）都不能接 this case 表示破案。
襯衫上的紅色汁液是早餐吃番茄 tomato 留下的。uniform（制服）、museum（博物館）、village（村莊）都不能吃，也不會流出紅色汁液。
checked the trash can「檢查垃圾桶」，找到了線索。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、prayed（禱告）都不能接 the trash can。
用草莓和芒果 mangoes 做生日蛋糕。tickets（票）、corners（角落）、bills（帳單）都不能做成蛋糕。

passages.zh: 星期天早上，媽媽打開冰箱，發現那盒草莓空了。「誰吃的？」她問。沒有人說話。我弟弟很愛看《名偵探柯南》之類的偵探卡通，他說：「我來破這個案子！」首先，他發現爸爸的襯衫上有紅色汁液，但爸爸說那是早餐吃番茄沾到的。接著，弟弟看看我們的貓 Momo，但貓不吃草莓。然後他檢查垃圾桶，找到一些草莓蒂頭，底下還壓著一張從奶奶筆記本撕下來的紙！奶奶笑了：「好啦，是我。我拿草莓去做了一個有芒果的蛋糕，要給你明天過生日。本來是要給你驚喜的！」

passages.title: 凌晨三點的豆漿店
passages.text: My family runs a small breakfast shop in Tainan. We sell soy milk, rice balls, and egg pancakes. Every day, my dad gets up at three o'clock to make fresh soy milk. The night before, he puts soy {1} in water. In the morning, he grinds them and {2} the milk in a big pot. It's hard work, but he never complains. On weekends, I help in the shop. Last summer, we started to sell a new drink: {3} soy milk. It's orange, sweet, and healthy. We also started to sell red {4} cakes. A food blogger posted a video about our shop, and suddenly we became very {5}. Now there's a long line every morning, and Dad has to get up at two!

blanks.why: soy beans「黃豆」，泡水後拿來磨豆漿。tickets（票）、letters（信）、offices（辦公室）都不能泡水磨成豆漿。
boil the milk「把豆漿煮沸」。spells（拼字）、marries（結婚）、prays（禱告）都不能接 the milk in a big pot。
pumpkin soy milk「南瓜豆漿」，橘色、甜甜的。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能加進豆漿裡。
red bean cakes「紅豆餅」。uniform（制服）、museum（博物館）、bill（帳單）都不能做成餅來賣。
影片爆紅後店變得很受歡迎 popular，每天大排長龍。wooden（木製的）、thick（厚的）、national（國家的）都不能說明為什麼會排隊。

passages.zh: 我家在台南開了一家小早餐店，賣豆漿、飯糰和蛋餅。每天我爸爸凌晨三點就起床做新鮮豆漿。前一晚，他會先把黃豆泡水；早上再把豆子磨碎，用大鍋把豆漿煮滾。工作很辛苦，但他從不抱怨。週末時我會到店裡幫忙。去年夏天，我們開始賣一種新飲料：南瓜豆漿，橘色的、甜甜的，又很健康。我們也開始賣紅豆餅。後來一位美食部落客貼了一支介紹我們店的影片，我們突然變得很紅。現在每天早上都大排長龍，爸爸得凌晨兩點就起床了！

passages.title: 南瓜種子的實驗
passages.text: In science class, our teacher gave each group some {1} seeds and three small pots. We put the first pot by the window, the second in a dark closet, and the third in the fridge. Every day, we {2} them and wrote notes. After one week, the seeds by the window grew green leaves. The ones in the closet grew too, but they were yellow and weak. The ones in the fridge didn't grow at all. Our teacher explained, "Plants need light and warm weather to grow well. Other plants, like {3} and {4}, are the same." At the end of the experiment, we planted our best one in the school garden. Three months later, it grew a big orange pumpkin! Our group was so {5} of it.

blanks.why: pumpkin seeds「南瓜種子」，最後長出了南瓜。garbage（垃圾）、traffic（交通）、weather（天氣）都不能接 seeds。
每天檢查 checked 種子並做紀錄。spelled（拼字）、married（結婚）、prayed（禱告）都不能接 them（種子）表示觀察。
豆子 beans 也是植物，一樣需要光和溫暖。offices（辦公室）、museums（博物館）、villages（村莊）都不是植物。
番茄 tomatoes 也是需要陽光的植物。tickets（票）、letters（信）、bills（帳單）都不會生長。
be proud of…「以…為榮」，種出了大南瓜。wooden（木製的）、cheap（便宜的）、thick（厚的）都不能接 of it 表示心情。

passages.zh: 自然課時，老師發給每組一些南瓜種子和三個小花盆。我們把第一盆放在窗邊，第二盆放進黑黑的櫃子裡，第三盆放進冰箱。每天我們都去檢查並做紀錄。一個星期後，窗邊的種子長出了綠葉；櫃子裡的也有長，但又黃又弱；冰箱裡的完全沒長。老師解釋：「植物需要光和溫暖的環境才能長得好。其他植物，像豆子和番茄，也是一樣。」實驗結束時，我們把長得最好的那株種到學校花園。三個月後，它結出了一顆大大的橘色南瓜！我們這組都為它感到好驕傲。
